scripts.prebuild: bun run --filter @waifufun/config build && bun run --filter @waifufun/fourmeme build && bun run --filter @waifufun/flap build
scripts.lint: biome check src test package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.test: sh -c 'files=$(find test src -name "*.test.ts" -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | tr "\n" " "); if [ -n "$files" ]; then node --import tsx --test $files; else echo "No tests found"; fi'
